text:
Alex: Opening RC candidate rc-20260322-1.0.0 — artifact docker.redwood/rc:1.0.0-sha1234. Planning full rollout after canary. Need SRE/QA/Security sign-off. Migration window reserved 03:00-03:30 UTC. @Nora please prewarm and share KV warm steps.

deploy-bot: Build 20260322-58 complete. Unit/integration tests: ✅. E2E: 1 failing (search_paging_test). Tagged rc-1.0.0.

Nora: Confirm SRE prewarm starting. Nodepool scale to +20% and KV warm plan: pre-populate top-10 prefixes, warm TTL caches.

Nora: Quick note — I'll run a dry-promote to canary in staging first.

deploy-bot: Dry promote to staging canary queued by Nora. Command: `/deploy dry-promote --artifact docker.redwood/rc:1.0.0-sha1234 --route canary:5 --env staging`

deploy-bot: Dry promote failed (healthcheck timeout on 1 pod). Error: pod-init script timed out.

Alex: Thanks, spotted. Nora, can you check init script (maybe DB migration hook race)?

Nora: Found culprit: metrics init blocked on external metrics provider timeout. Pushing fix — small change to init timeout. Will re-run dry-promote in 2m.

deploy-bot: Dry promote to staging canary successful at 02:45 UTC. 5% traffic. Health: OK.

Priya: QA smoke on staging canary: 102/104 passed. Failures are unrelated flaky timeouts; retesting now. No regressions on primary flows.

qa-bot: Smoke summary: 102/104. flaky_tests: [timebound_test, pagination_test]. Logs: https://ci.redwood/rc/1.0.0/smoke.log

Ben: Security quick scan: secret-scan clean, KMS integration verified. One note: runtime uses new 3rd-party SHA lib (v2.1) — I opened sec PR with pin recommendation. Need to include in release notes and consider short lock.

Alex: Thanks Ben. Add the dependency note to release notes and pin on deploy. If any CVE appears within the next hour we abort.

Nora: Canary plan: 5% for 10m, 25% for 15m, then 100% after migration and green signals. Deadman auto-rollback: enabled (deadman-bot will trigger if 1-minute error burst > 5%).

Alex: Rollback options (documented): 1) `/ops/revert.sh --tag rc-1.0.0-sha1234` (repoint infra to previous tag); 2) feature-flag toggle `feature.flag.search_v1=true`; 3) DB restore from /backups/pre-1.0.0.sql if data migration issues. Keep these commands in front of oncall.

Nora: Adding quick rollback snippet here:
```bash
# revert image and routes
./ops/revert.sh --to-tag docker.redwood/rc:0.9.7-sha999 --force
# feature toggle fallback
./ops/feature-toggle --set feature.flag.search_v1=true --env prod
```

Alex: Noted. I'll set PagerDuty thresholds: if error_rate > 1% for 3m OR p99 latency > 2x baseline for 5m -> trigger P1 and rollback.

deadman-bot: Deadman configured: error_rate_threshold=5% (1m), p99_multiplier=2.0 (5m). Will auto-trigger `/ops/revert.sh` if breached and confirmed by oncall.

Priya: Re-run of flaky tests passed on retry. QA gives green for canary progression.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 5% canary in prod initiated at 03:02 UTC. 5% traffic routed. Health checks OK.

Nora: KV warm completed pre-canary. Observability: p95 +12ms on search, within acceptable window.

deploy-bot: After 10m checks, promoting to 25% at 03:12 UTC.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 25% complete at 03:13 UTC. Metrics: error_rate 0.09%, p99 stable.

Priya: Quick smoke on 25% — core flows pass, pagination issue not reproduced. QA approves ramp to 100% post-migration.

Alex: Starting DB migration job at 03:20 UTC (online backfill). Watchers: Nora, Priya. Migration script: ./db/migrate_v2_backfill.sh --batch-size 1000

Nora: Migration progress: 20% after 5m, no lock contention observed.

deploy-bot: Migration completed at 03:26 UTC. Post-migration checks: data integrity OK.

Alex: Proceeding to full rollout. Final safety: 1) deadman enabled; 2) PD thresholds set; 3) rollback snippet at hand.

deploy-bot: Full rollout started at 03:28 UTC. Routing change in progress.

deploy-bot: Full rollout complete at 03:31 UTC. Health check summary: error_rate 0.07%, p99 within SLA.

Ben: Security note: dependency pin PR merged to lock SHA lib v2.1 -> v2.1.1 pin. No runtime secrets exposed.

Priya: QA: running post-rollout smoke — all core paths green. Closing QA sign-off.

Nora: SRE: infra stable, no pod churn, KV caches healthy.

Alex: All sign-offs collected (SRE Nora, QA Priya, Security Ben). RC promoted to GA. I'll publish release notes and send customer communication. If anyone sees issues, follow rollback steps and ping #ops. Thanks everyone :tada:
